Among students who were accepted into this law program, the average standing was the sixth decile, placing them squarely in the middle of their class. Your early academic struggles were the strongest signal pushing the model toward predicting failure.

The second most important factor was your standing in your third year, where you improved slightly to the third decile. While this shows progress, you still remained well below the accepted-student average of roughly the sixth decile. This persistent pattern of below-average performance reinforced the model's concern.
